atAGlance: Bánh cam is a fried sesame ball with a crisp chewy shell and sweet mung bean filling. It is snacky, round, and best fresh.
whatItIs: Bánh cam is a Vietnamese sesame ball, a fried glutinous rice pastry with sweet filling.
howToEnjoy: Eat while fresh so the sesame shell stays crisp around the mung bean center. Bite carefully; the inside can be warm.
howLocalsOrder: Order bánh cam by piece at a snack stall. Ask for freshly fried ones if you see a batch coming out.
worthKnowing: This is a familiar shape across Chinese-Vietnamese and Southeast Asian snack worlds, but local fillings and texture vary.
goodToKnow: The outside should be crisp-chewy while the filling stays soft. Freshness matters.
